terms.lead: Clear rules for online stay requests — what confirmation by the guesthouse means.

terms.s2Body: Minimum one night. Check-in and check-out times are those communicated when we confirm.

privacy.useBody: To respond to your stay request, confirm availability, and manage your booking.

privacy.retentionBody: We keep data as long as needed to manage the booking and meet legal obligations (accounting, tax).
privacy.rightsBody: You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and portability. Contact <email>contact@hospira.ro</email>.

pricing.pageTitle: Plans that grow with your property
pricing.pageLead: Start free with 3 rooms. Upgrade only when you need to — no contract, no penalties.
pricing.gridLead: Prices in EUR, billed monthly. Cancel anytime.
pricing.vatNote: Prices shown exclude VAT. Local and hybrid deployments available on request.
pricing.comparisonLead: All plans include calendar, bookings and a public presentation page.
pricing.faq1Q: Can I really start at 0 EUR?
pricing.faq1A: Yes. Free includes 3 rooms, calendar and online bookings — no card, no time limit.
pricing.faq2Q: When should I move to Essential (19 EUR)?
pricing.faq2A: When you need Gantt, email notifications, visual themes, or up to 10 rooms and 3 team members.
pricing.faq3A: Up to 30 rooms, unlimited team, custom domain, no Hospira branding, plus iCal and advanced reports.
pricing.faq4A: Larger properties or small chains: unlimited rooms, up to 5 properties, invoicing, WhatsApp, API and dedicated onboarding.

footer.tagline: Modern software for guesthouses and small hotels in Romania, Moldova and Bulgaria.
